title: Add GATEKEEPER to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [GATEKEEPER](https://khuzaima3232.github.io/gatekeeper) to games
- A 60-second arcade arena whose rules are written live by an AI. Before every run, a language model invents the terms of that run - which colour sustains you, which colour is fatal on contact, whether 

Fixes #15341

gist.headline: The rules bloom mid-run
gist.blurb: GATEKEEPER has entered the games garden: a tiny arcade arena where the rulebook is written just before the buzzer. Polli recommends reading which colour is fatal before introducing yourself to it.
gist.summary: Added GATEKEEPER to the games collection, a 60-second AI-authored arcade arena where a language model defines each run's sustaining and fatal colours before play begins.
gist.impact: Players can now jump into a fresh GATEKEEPER run with shifting, model-written survival rules instead of a fixed arcade rulebook.
gist.visual_concept: Depict GATEKEEPER as a cozy arcade arena with a retro rule terminal generating a new colour-coded survival notice. Polli, wearing a tiny referee visor, studies the glowing rules while hopping between friendly colour tiles and avoiding clearly marked fatal ones; code-plants and pixel flowers soften the arena edges.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of GATEKEEPER, a small 60-second arcade arena where a retro CRT terminal writes live colour rules in chunky pixel text: 'GREEN = SAFE' and 'PURPLE = AVOID'; Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with light-blue wings, pink blush, and a tiny referee visor, carefully hops toward the safe lime green (#ecf874) tiles beside flowering code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm and playful.
